theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_blowUp_tendsto_halfSpace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, ∀ K : Set (Rn (n + 1)), IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (K ∩ symmDiff (blowUpMap x r '' E) {y | 0 < inner ℝ y (reducedNormal μ ν x)})) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
